card.name: Quantity word before day or time
card.fires_on: Words like some, one, each, every, other, many and these that come right before a noun such as day, time, ways or days. The pole fires on that determiner, just before the noun is expected.

modes.label: Before day
modes.description: A determiner such as one, some, other or these precedes the word day or days.
modes.example: Paging through a magazine<< one>> day in 1984,

modes.label: Before time
modes.description: each or every right before the word time, meaning on each occasion.
modes.example: learns to turn out a perfectly cooked piece of fish<< every>> time.

modes.label: Other counted nouns
modes.description: A quantity word before ways or year in a repeated phrase.
modes.example: "In" gets used so<< many>> ways, in so many different combinations,

card.writes: It pushes the model toward nouns of time and span, such as distance, ways, nights and seasons.
card.plain: It marks a small word like "one" or "each" that is about to be followed by "day" or "time".
